name: VulnCheck (KEV index, community API)
tier_rationale: Established security company with published service terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 trusted); P186 cond 4 'Registry provider vulncheck: tier trusted, terms key-terms'.

reliability.justification: Curated exploitation evidence (reported exploitation references, exploit database) broader and often earlier than CISA KEV; kept apart from CISA KEV (P186 cond 3).

vulncheck.description: VulnCheck API token (Bearer header; community tier gives the vulncheck-kev index)
vulncheck.plan_hint: community token of a COMPANY account created under the corporate identity, never a personal one (rule 1); legal records in key_plans.vulncheck whether it falls under the Service Terms (Free Offering) or a paid plan before corporate use (P186 cond 2)

kev_index.title: VulnCheck KEV index GET /v3/index/vulncheck-kev?cve={cve} (Bearer key)

terms.quote: Licence: VulnCheck's site licence is 'personal, internal and non-commercial' while its Service Terms (rev. 6 Jul 2026) treat a community version as a Free Offering: legal records that the team's community key falls under the Service Terms, or a paid plan, in key_plans before corporate use.

kev_index.notes: Quote: binding council text (P186 cond 2); research C0439 (verified_needs_key: keyless 401 {"error":true,"errors":["unauthorized"]}). Under the corporate profile it runs only with key_plans.vulncheck = 'business' (legal decision). VulnCheck data is not made available to third parties (P186 cond 3): exports carry only the CVE id and the exploited flag. No published quota for the community tier: one request per CVE, min_interval 1 s, CVE fan-out rule (P183 cond 3). The offline variant on the daily vulncheck-kev backup (GET /v3/backup/vulncheck-kev, a pre-signed download URL) waits for the team key to confirm the community tier may use it (P186 cond 1, docs/backlog/p2-G08-1.md).

notes: Owned by batch p2-G08-1 (P186 vulncheck, default off). The key belongs to a company account (rule 1).
